_comment: PSIV 68000 work-RAM map for the emulator oracle.
This file is the single source of truth. oracle/gen_ram_map.py emits the
flat ram_map.tsv the C host reads; oracle/verify.sh regenerates and diffs
it so the two cannot drift apart silently.
Every address below is transcribed from
reference/ps4disasm/ps4.constants.asm and carries the line it came from.
Nothing here was inferred by watching memory. Struct fields are recorded
as base + offset with both line numbers so the arithmetic is auditable.
Addresses are 68000 addresses ($FFFFxxxx). The host converts to the
core's work_ram indexing; see host/psiv_oracle.c for the byte-order note.

curr_x_pos.note: longword; high word is the whole-pixel position, see ps4.asm:11850
